clips.title: The story
paras: The severed head of Gath'Ilzogg serves as indisputable proof that the Blackrock warlord has been slain. Claiming it breaks the leadership behind the siege of Stonewatch Keep and brings desperate relief to the town of Lakeshire.

Gath'Ilzogg orchestrated the brutal Blackrock assault that overran Stonewatch Keep, driving out its defenders and subjecting the surrounding valley to relentless raiding. With Lakeshire on the verge of ruin and Stormwind offering virtually no military reinforcements, Magistrate Solomon posted a bounty upon the warlord's head. Slaying Gath'Ilzogg within the fortified upper levels of Stonewatch and claiming his head shatters the local Blackrock leadership, marking the first real step toward reclaiming the keep for the kingdom.
